# Empty

> Empty-state layout for blank lists, zero results, and new workspaces.

Status: beta.

This file matches the installed `empty` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/empty.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/empty.md`.

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

## Composition

### Anatomy

```tsx
<Empty>
  <EmptyHeader>
    <EmptyMedia />
    <EmptyTitle />
    <EmptyDescription />
  </EmptyHeader>
  <EmptyContent>
    <Button />
  </EmptyContent>
</Empty>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { Inbox } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button";
import { Empty, EmptyContent, EmptyDescription, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/empty";

export function PrimitiveEmptyExample() {
  return (
    <Empty variant="outline" className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <EmptyHeader>
        <EmptyMedia>
          <Inbox />
        </EmptyMedia>
        <EmptyTitle>No messages yet</EmptyTitle>
        <EmptyDescription>Start a conversation and every thread you open will collect here for quick access.</EmptyDescription>
      </EmptyHeader>
      <EmptyContent>
        <Button variant="solid" size="sm">
          New message
        </Button>
      </EmptyContent>
    </Empty>
  );
}
```
